description:
Activate Evolutionary Leap by paying {G} and sacrificing Kin-Tree Warden.
When Kin-Tree Warden dies, Yedora triggers, returning Kin-Tree Warden from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Kin-Tree Warden enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evolutionary Leap ability, causing you to reveal a creature card from your library and put it into your hand.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Repeat.
